Profile Summary

Barclays, Pune as Data Analyst May 2023 - Present

▪ ▪ Actively collaborating with subject matter experts (SMEs) within the business to understand the line of business

Experienced in working as a Data Analyst and delivering the data lineage and maintenance process.

British Petroleum, Pune as Data Operations Administrator Feb 2021- Oct 2022

Functional responsibilities:

▪ Working on large data concepts and data sourcing, data integration, data loading. ▪ ▪

Identification of critical data elements in different systems. collaborating with senior stakeholders to identify the data lineage, data owners, establishing the data quality rules and maintain data quality.

▪ Support in proper communication regarding metadata changes to customers. ▪

Prepare reports, documents, metrics and presentations and exchange ideas/information in logical manner, Checking the data quality parameters.

▪ Verify the documents & files and adding the data attributes into the tool and system. ▪ Execution of material master data maintenance tasks with high quality and accuracy.

▪ Working on the large materials and vendor details files and sorting the files and data cleansing activity. ▪ Making the data visualization and Reports on the Excel and Power BI tools. ▪ Good understanding and knowledge of Data governance tool. ▪

collaborate and communicate frequently with Process Owners, Data Providers.

systems/products/regions.

customers and US team.
